2.88.35
Chart.NoRows
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Chart.NoRows element specifies the title to display if a Chart contains no data. This element is
optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1).
Following is the parent element of the Chart.NoRows element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.NoRows element.
 <xsd:element name="NoRows" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
